plan.goal: Find and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase and NADPHX epimerase activity, then rank candidates.
assumptions: GO term search will resolve the correct molecular function terms for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase and NADPHX epimerase activities.
Swiss-Prot reviewed sequences are preferred for representativeness and annotation quality.
Excluding IEA (electronically inferred) annotations improves reliability for these enzymatic activities.
Sequence-level compositional and motif analysis is sufficient for ranking NAD(P)HX repair protein candidates without requiring predicted structures.
The two activity classes share the NAD(P)HX repair function and can be ranked together as a unified candidate set after independent retrieval.
